<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス：防衛線</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分のエコー基地兵員はここでは配備コスト－１。ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Hoth-Defensive-Perimeter-3rd-Marker-SWCA-100684.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker).

'''Light Side:'''
Your Echo Base Troopers may deploy here for 1 less. If you control this site, Force drain plus 1.

'''Dark Side:'''
If you control this site, Force drain plus 1.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Force icon counts and both side effects match the English original.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
